Adjustment.description: A signed, labelled amount added to the free cash flow of a period.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Disposal of a warehouse". Not empty.

value.description:
Amount in currency units: positive for an inflow (for example proceeds from a disposal),
negative for an outflow.

BridgeClaim.description:
A claim on the value of the company other than the net financial position, subtracted from
enterprise value to reach equity value: a debt-like item or a non-controlling interest
(R25). Fairmark subtracts the amount as given and does not choose how it is measured.

basis_note.description:
Free text that qualifies the basis, for example "net of tax" or "49% of the book value
of equity of the subsidiary"; required with `other`, optional otherwise, never empty
when given. Reported, never used in the calculation.

label.description:
What the claim is, for example "Unfunded pension obligation" or "30% of Subsidiary A".
Not empty.

measurement_basis.description:
How the amount was measured, stated by the analyst: `book_value`, `market_value`,
`fair_value`, `present_value` or `other` (then describe it in `basis_note`). Required,
no default. Reported with the amount, never used in the calculation.

value.description: Amount at the valuation date, in currency units, zero or more; subtracted.

ExitMultipleTerminal.description:
The terms of `tv.exit_multiple` inside the DCF: the metric must be on the basis of the DCF
(`ebitda`, `ebit` or `revenue` for the enterprise basis).

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the implied growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none,
reported as absent. Needs `next_flow`. Exceeding it is reported, not refused.

metric.description:
`ebitda`, `ebit`, `revenue` (enterprise basis), `earnings` or `book_value` (equity
basis); must be on the basis of the DCF.

metric_value.description:
The metric at the horizon N (trailing), in currency units, greater than 0, in the terms
of the cash flows.

multiple.description: The multiple, a pure number greater than 0 (for example 8 for 8 × EBITDA).

next_flow.description:
Flow at N + 1 on the basis of the DCF, in currency units, in the terms of the cash
flows. Optional: when given, the perpetual growth implied by the multiple is computed
at the terminal rate.

FirstTerminalFlow.description: The flow at N + 1 of a technique that grows the last explicit flow (R20).

oneOf.description:
The technique grows the last explicit flow CF_N (`tv.gordon`: CF_N × (1 + g);
`tv.h_model`: its own formula).
CF_{N+1} given in `normalised_next_flow`.

FreeCashFlowLines.description: The line items of one period, after reclassification (SPEC-0005).

capital_expenditure.description:
Capital expenditure of the period, in currency units, zero or more; subtracted.
Disposals go in `other_adjustments` with a positive sign.

change_in_net_working_capital.description:
Change in net working capital of the period, in currency units: positive for an
increase, which absorbs cash and is subtracted; negative for a decrease.

depreciation_and_amortisation.description: Depreciation and amortisation of the period, in currency units, zero or more; added back.

ebit.description: EBIT (earnings before interest and taxes) of the period, in currency units; any sign.

interest_expense.description:
Interest expense of the period, in currency units, zero or more. Give it with
`net_borrowing`, for every period or for none, to obtain the FCFE. Default: none.

net_borrowing.description:
Net borrowing of the period, in currency units: positive for new borrowing, negative for
net repayment. Give it with `interest_expense`. Default: none.

operating_taxes.description:
Taxes on EBIT of the period, in currency units, positive for a tax paid (amounts form).
Give it for every period and omit `notional_tax_rate`, or omit it everywhere and give
`notional_tax_rate`. Default: none.

other_adjustments.description:
Other labelled adjustments, each positive for an inflow and negative for an outflow.
Default: none.

GordonTerminal.description:
The terms of `tv.gordon` inside the DCF: the rate is the terminal rate of the DCF and the
last flow is the last explicit flow.

growth.description:
Perpetual growth after the horizon, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and
below the terminal rate, in the terms of the cash flows.

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none,
reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

normalised_next_flow.description:
The flow at N + 1 in currency units, in the terms of the cash flows; required with
`first_flow` = `normalised_next_flow`, refused otherwise.

HModelFirstFlow.description: The flow CF_N on which `tv.h_model` is computed (R20, Decision 15).

oneOf.description: The last explicit flow CF_N, grown by the H-model formula.

A normalised base flow at N, given in `normalised_base_flow`, replaces the last explicit
flow; the standard formula applies, with no conversion from N + 1.

HModelTerminal.description:
The terms of `tv.h_model` inside the DCF: the rate is the terminal rate of the DCF and the
flow CF_N is the last explicit flow or a normalised base flow at N (Decision 15).

first_flow.description:
`last_flow_grown` (the H-model grows the last explicit flow CF_N) or
`normalised_base_flow` (a normalised CF_N given in `normalised_base_flow`); no default.

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the long-term growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none,
reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

half_life.description:
Half-life H, in periods: the decline from g_s to g_l lasts 2H periods. Zero or
positive; may be fractional.

long_term_growth.description:
Stable growth reached after 2H periods and kept forever, g_l, decimal fraction per
period, greater than -1 and below the terminal rate, in the terms of the cash flows.

normalised_base_flow.description:
The normalised base flow CF_N at the horizon N, in currency units, in the terms of the
cash flows; required with `first_flow` = `normalised_base_flow`, refused otherwise.

short_term_growth.description:
Growth at the start of the decline, g_s, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1,
in the terms of the cash flows.

LimitedHorizonTerminal.description:
The terms of `tv.limited_horizon` inside the DCF: the rate is the terminal rate of the DCF.
Every term is required, with no default (R29).

flow.description:
First flow after the horizon, at the end of period N + 1, in currency units, in the
terms of the cash flows.

growth.description: Growth of the flow per period, decimal fraction, greater than -1; 0 for a constant flow.

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as
absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

periods.description: Number of further periods n during which the flow lasts, from 1 to 10000.

residual_value.description:
Residual value at the end of period N + n, in currency units, in the terms of the cash
flows; 0 for none.

Line.description: A labelled amount, for example an asset and its realisable value.

label.description: What the amount is, for example "Land" or "Bank loan". Not empty.

value.description: Amount in currency units, zero or positive.

LiquidationTerminal.description:
The terms of `tv.liquidation` inside the DCF: the declared basis must be the basis of the
DCF.

assets.description:
Assets with their realisable values at N, in currency units, in the terms of the cash
flows, each zero or positive; at least one.

basis.description:
`enterprise` (the liabilities listed exclude financial debt) or `equity` (financial debt
included); must be the basis of the DCF. Required, no default.

liabilities.description:
Liabilities settled at N, in currency units, in the terms of the cash flows, each zero
or positive.

liquidation_costs.description:
Costs of the liquidation (legal fees, closure, severance), in currency units, in the
terms of the cash flows, each zero or positive.

tax_on_gains.description:
Tax on the gains realised, as an amount in currency units, in the terms of the cash
flows, zero or positive.

MeasurementBasis.description:
How the amount of a bridge claim was measured (Decision 21). Fairmark does not choose the
basis: the analyst states it and the result reports it next to the amount.

oneOf.description: Book value per the accounts at the valuation date.
Quoted market price at the valuation date.
Fair value as defined by IFRS 13.
Present value of the obligation, for example unfunded pensions or provisions.
Another basis, described in `basis_note` (required).

MultipleMetric.description:
The metric a multiple applies to. Enterprise multiples (EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales) give
an enterprise value; P/E and P/BV give an equity value. The two are never mixed.

oneOf.description: EBITDA at N; multiple EV/EBITDA, enterprise basis.
EBIT at N; multiple EV/EBIT, enterprise basis.
Revenue at N; multiple EV/Sales, enterprise basis.
Net earnings at N; multiple P/E, equity basis.

Book value of equity at N; multiple P/BV (price to book value), equity basis
(SPEC-0006 decision of 2026-11-08).

NegativeEbit.description: Tax on a negative EBIT when the taxes are computed from a rate (SPEC-0001 R4).

oneOf.description: Taxes = rate × EBIT also when EBIT is negative: a tax saving that raises the flow.
No tax when EBIT is negative.

NetFinancialPosition.description:
The net financial position with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6). Fairmark adds what is
given and does not choose which items are included.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents, in currency units, subtracted from the gross debt.

gross_debt.description: Gross financial debt (bank loans, bonds and other borrowings), in currency units.

other_items.description: Other items included by the analyst, each added with its sign. Default: none.

NfpItem.description: One item of the net financial position other than gross debt and cash.

amount.description:
Amount in currency units, added to the net financial position: positive for debt-like
items, negative for financial assets.

name.description: What the item is, for example "lease liabilities" or "derivative assets".

NormalisedIncomeTerminal.description:
The terms of `tv.normalised_income` inside the DCF: the capitalisation rate is the terminal
rate of the DCF (R19, Decision 13); no separate capitalisation rate is accepted.

basis.description:
`enterprise` (an operating income) or `equity` (a net income); must be the basis of the
DCF. Required, no default.

growth.description:
Perpetual growth of the income, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below
the terminal rate, in the terms of the cash flows; 0 for none (R / i).

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none, reported as
absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

income.description:
Normalised income R of the first period after the horizon, in currency units, in the
terms of the cash flows.

Projection.description: How the flows of a stage are obtained (Decision 3).

oneOf.description:
The flows are given, one per period, in `flows`, or built up from line items in
`lines` (exactly one of the two).
Each flow is the previous flow × (1 + `growth`).

The growth moves from `from_growth` to `to_growth` in equal steps,
g_k = g_from + (g_to − g_from) × k / m, reaching `to_growth` in the last period
(Decision 4).

Stage.description:
One explicit stage: a number of periods and how its flows are obtained. Each projection
takes only its own fields: `flows` or `lines` for `given`, `growth` for `constant_growth`,
`from_growth` and `to_growth` for `linear_decline`.

flows.description:
For `given`: the flows of the stage in currency units, exactly one per period, in the
terms of `cash_flow_terms`.

from_growth.description:
For `linear_decline`: the growth before the stage, decimal fraction per period, greater
than -1.

growth.description: For `constant_growth`: growth per period, decimal fraction, greater than -1.

lines.description:
For `given`, instead of `flows`: the line items of each period (EBIT, taxes on EBIT,
depreciation and amortisation, capital expenditure, change in net working capital,
adjustments), exactly one per period, in currency units in the terms of
`cash_flow_terms`; the flow of each period is built up as in `dcf.free_cash_flows`, with
the tax fields of the method (SPEC-0001 R7). `interest_expense` and `net_borrowing` apply
only where FCFE is discounted: they are refused on the enterprise basis (`dcf.fcff`).

periods.description: Number of periods of the stage, at least 1; one period is one year.

to_growth.description:
For `linear_decline`: the growth of the last period of the stage, decimal fraction per
period, greater than -1.

Terminal.description:
The terminal technique, written as an object with exactly one key, the `tv.*` method id,
as in `tv.compare`: `{"tv.gordon": {...}}`.

tv.exit_multiple.description:
The business sold at a multiple of a metric at N (`tv.exit_multiple`): `multiple`,
`metric`, `metric_value`, optional `next_flow` and `growth_cap`.

tv.h_model.description:
Growth declining linearly to a stable rate (`tv.h_model`) on the last explicit flow:
`short_term_growth`, `long_term_growth`, `half_life`, `first_flow`, optional
`growth_cap`.

tv.limited_horizon.description:
A flow lasting n more periods, then a residual value (`tv.limited_horizon`): `flow`,
`periods`, `growth`, `residual_value`, optional `growth_cap`.

tv.liquidation.description:
Assets realised and liabilities settled at N (`tv.liquidation`): `assets`,
`liabilities`, `liquidation_costs`, `tax_on_gains`, `basis`.

tv.normalised_income.description:
A normalised income capitalised at the terminal rate (`tv.normalised_income`): `income`,
`basis`, `growth`, optional `growth_cap`.

tv.value_driver.description:
Stable growth earned by reinvestment (`tv.value_driver`): `nopat_next`, `growth`,
`ronic`, optional `growth_cap`.

TerminalBasis.description: Whether a terminal value is a value of the whole business or of its equity.

oneOf.description:
Enterprise value: flows to all capital providers (FCFF), discounted at the WACC;
multiples EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales.

Equity value: flows to shareholders (FCFE, dividends), discounted at the cost of
equity; multiple P/E.

TerminalDiscountTime.description: When the terminal value is discounted under mid-period timing (Decision 6).

oneOf.description: At the horizon, t = N: factor DF_N.

Half a period earlier, t = N − 0.5: factor DF_N × (1 + r_T)^0.5, with r_T the terminal
rate.

Terms.description: Whether amounts and growth rates, or discount rates, include expected inflation.

oneOf.description: At current prices: expected inflation included.
At constant prices: expected inflation excluded.

Timing.description:
When cash flows arrive within each period.

Rates are always decimal fractions per period: `0.10` means 10%.

oneOf.description: Cash flows at the end of each period (t = 1, 2, ..., n).
Cash flows spread evenly, discounted at mid period (t = 0.5, 1.5, ...).

ValueDriverTerminal.description: The terms of `tv.value_driver` inside the DCF: the rate is the terminal rate of the DCF.

growth.description:
Perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1 and below the terminal
rate, in the terms of the cash flows.

growth_cap.description:
Upper bound for the perpetual growth, decimal fraction per period. Default: none,
reported as absent. A growth above the cap is reported, not refused.

nopat_next.description:
Net operating profit after tax of the first period after the horizon, NOPAT_{N+1}, in
currency units, in the terms of the cash flows.

ronic.description: Return on new invested capital (RONIC), decimal fraction per period, greater than 0.

description: Input of `dcf.fcfe` (version 1). Every choice is required, with no default (R29).

base_flow.description:
FCFE of the base period CF_0, in currency units: required when the first stage is
`constant_growth` or `linear_decline`, refused when it is `given`.

cash_flow_terms.description: `nominal` or `real`: the terms of every amount and growth rate of the input.

cost_of_equity.description:
One cost of equity for every period and for the terminal value, decimal fraction
per period (0.11 = 11%), greater than -1. Give this or `cost_of_equity_per_period`,
not both.

cost_of_equity_per_period.description:
One cost of equity per period of the explicit horizon, decimal fractions, exactly N
of them, each greater than -1; requires `terminal_cost_of_equity`. Give this or
`cost_of_equity`, not both.

debt_like_items.description:
Debt-like items (debt equivalents) at the valuation date whose cash flows are not in
the FCFE, for example unfunded pension obligations, each a label, a value in
currency units (zero or more) and its measurement basis; subtracted. Default: none,
reported.

discount_rate_terms.description:
`nominal` or `real`: the terms of the discount rates. When they differ from
`cash_flow_terms`, expected inflation is required (`inflation`, or
`inflation_per_period` with `terminal_inflation`) and every rate is converted to the
terms of the cash flows; the cash flows are never converted.

inflation.description:
Expected inflation, decimal fraction per period (0.02 = 2%), greater than -1, for every
explicit period and for the terminal phase. Give this or `inflation_per_period`, or
neither. With different terms it converts the discount rates by the exact Fisher
relation; with equal terms it only restates the perpetual growth in the other terms.
Default: none.

inflation_per_period.description:
Expected inflation per period of the explicit horizon, decimal fractions, exactly N of
them, each greater than -1; requires `terminal_inflation`. Give this or `inflation`,
not both. Default: none.

interest_tax_rate.description:
For stages with `lines` and `operating_taxes`: the tax rate t of the interest tax
shield, interest × (1 − t), decimal fraction from 0 to below 1; required in that case,
refused otherwise. Default: none.

negative_ebit.description:
For stages with `lines` and `notional_tax_rate`: treatment of a negative EBIT, `credit`
(taxes = rate × EBIT) or `zero` (no tax; the interest tax shield is limited to the
taxable income, rate × min(interest, max(EBIT, 0)), Decision 22); required with
`notional_tax_rate`, no default.

net_financial_position.description:
Not used on the equity basis and refused (`FM-E019`): debt is already in the FCFE,
through interest and net borrowing, so the net financial position is not
subtracted. Cash that the FCFE does not reflect goes in `non_operating_assets`.
Accepted by the schema only so that the refusal names the fix.

non_controlling_interests.description:
Non-controlling interests (minority interests) at the valuation date, when the FCFE
are those of the consolidated group, each a label, a value in currency units (zero
or more) and its measurement basis; subtracted. Default: none, reported.

non_operating_assets.description:
Non-operating assets at the valuation date, each a label and a value in currency
units (zero or more), added to the present value of the FCFE and of the terminal
value: for example cash not needed for operations whose interest income is not in
the FCFE, or an investment property. Default: none, reported.

notional_tax_rate.description:
For stages with `lines`: tax rate applied to EBIT, decimal fraction from 0 to below 1
(0.24 = 24%), also the rate of the interest tax shield. Give this, or
`operating_taxes` in every line, not both; refused when no stage has `lines`. Default:
none.

stages.description:
One to three explicit stages of free cash flows to equity (FCFE), in order; the
explicit horizon N is the sum of their periods. Each stage is `{"periods",
"projection", ...}` with the fields of its projection; a `given` stage takes the FCFE
as amounts (`flows`) or builds them up from line items with `interest_expense` and
`net_borrowing` in every line (`lines`).

terminal.description:
The terminal technique on the equity basis, an object with exactly one key, the method
id, for example `{"tv.gordon": {"growth", "first_flow", ...}}`: `tv.gordon`,
`tv.h_model` or `tv.limited_horizon` on the FCFE, `tv.exit_multiple` on `earnings`
(P/E) or `book_value` (P/BV), `tv.normalised_income` or `tv.liquidation` declared on
the `equity` basis. `tv.value_driver` is refused: its NOPAT and RONIC are firm-level
quantities (SPEC-0001 Decision 23).

terminal_cost_of_equity.description:
Cost of equity of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1;
required with `cost_of_equity_per_period`, refused with `cost_of_equity`.

terminal_discount_time.description:
With `mid_period` timing, required: `horizon` (terminal value at t = N) or
`mid_period` (t = N − 0.5). Refused with `end_of_period`.

terminal_inflation.description:
Expected inflation of the terminal phase, decimal fraction per period, greater than -1;
required with `inflation_per_period`, refused otherwise.

timing.description: `end_of_period` (flow k at t = k) or `mid_period` (t = k − 0.5); no default.

title: DcfFcfeInput
